exposure: gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis and treatment
cohort: 95 pregnant Hispanic women of Mexican origin living along the U.S.–Mexico border who delivered between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2017.
finding: No significant differences were found between women diagnosed and treated for GDM (two abnormal 3-hour OGTT) and those with only one abnormal 3-hour OGTT in terms of sociodemographic variables, hyperbilirubinemia, or other adverse neonatal outcomes, however C-sections were more common in women with GDM.
mod_finding: C-sections were more common in women with GDM.
